metadata.title: Rustic Sepia Portrait with Slab Serif Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, grainy sepia-toned portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, characterized by high-contrast highlights and a dense, gritty texture. The composition is bisected near the top by a thin red horizontal line that serves as a baseline for lowercase slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The red horizontal line acts as a structural anchor between the text and the subject's hat.
The coarse grain of the image creates a tactile, weathered feel that contrasts with the clean vector lines of the type.
The subject's eyes are positioned centrally, creating a direct gaze with the viewer beneath the brim of the hat.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or stipple texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait, filling the frame from the chest up, with the cowboy hat dominating the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal red line located at approximately the upper 1/6th of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold white text, follows the red line across, then drops down to the subject's eyes and facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and hat occupy nearly the entire frame, with the background being a textured gradient of the same sepia tones.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep sepia/umber for shadows and midtones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/off-white for highlights and text fill.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the thin horizontal rule.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall, relying on value contrast and texture rather than hue variety.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a closed loop descender that sits below the red line.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the top of the hat

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact against the busy texture.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule (1-2pt weight) in red.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic slab serif with geometric qualities and sturdy presence.
Provides a typewriter-adjacent western feel with distinct slabs.
Modern slab serif with excellent legibility and similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy sepia-toned portrait of a man wearing a cowboy hat. The image should have a heavy stipple or film grain texture, with bright cream highlights on the face and deep umber shadows. The hat should be dark and occupy the top third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin red horizontal line across the top third of the image. Place lowercase slab-serif text in white/cream so that the letters sit directly on top of the red line, with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the red line perfectly horizontal and thin?
Does the image have a visible, coarse grain texture?
Is the color palette restricted to sepia, cream, and red?

adjustableVariables: Vertical position of the red line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean, modern typographic layout over a vintage-style image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red line does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Check that the grain doesn't make the text illegible.
Verify the duotone effect is consistent across the entire frame.
Confirm the slab serifs are thick and blocky.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-grain duotone portrait with a minimalist geometric rule and wide-tracked slab serif typography for a modern-vintage Americana aesthetic.
